items.title: Pina's fake Norm Powell trades had me trying to come up with a few of my own.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
Pina's fake Norm Powell trades had me trying to come up with a few of my own.

The more I tried, the more I kept coming back to the same thing.

Powell could be useful to a contender without being valuable enough for that contender to give the Bulls anything exciting.
